title: Among Protestants, the Remonstrants by common consent approve middle knowledge
source_text: XXII. Quod spectat autem Protestantes, variae quoque sunt eorum hac de re sententiae. Et primo quidem illi qui in Belgio Remonstrantes vocantur, videntur communi consensu scientiam illam mediam qualis hactenus descripta est probare, & agnoscere Deum non solum quae sunt absolute futura praevidere, sed etiam quaecunque libere futura essent, in quocunque rerum ordine Deo placeret agentia libera collocare.
pass_a_gloss: XXII. But as concerns the Protestants, their opinions on this matter are also various. And first indeed those who in the Low Countries are called Remonstrants, seem by common consent to approve that middle knowledge such as has hitherto been described, and to acknowledge that God foresees not only those things which are absolutely future, but also whatever would be freely future, in whatever order of things it should please God to place free agents.
pass_b_english: Protestant views on this matter also vary. First, those in the Netherlands called Remonstrants seem by common consent to approve of middle knowledge as described so far.
They acknowledge that God foresees not only what will absolutely happen, but also whatever would happen freely in any order of things in which God might choose to place free agents.

choices.why: The Molinist technical term; 'middle knowledge' is the established English name and is kept throughout.
